item.title: Lakota East football coach Jon Kitna gives proponent testimony for Ohio House Bill 661
item.description: Lakota East football coach Jon Kitna, a former NFL quarterback, gave proponent testimony for Ohio House Bill 661 regarding name, image and likeness in Ohio High School Athletic Association sports.

item.title: Lakota West boys hoops student-athlete filed litigation against OHSAA in fall about eligibility
item.description: A Lakota West boys basketball student-athlete filed litigation against the Ohio High School Athletic Association during the fall season to address his eligibility.

item.title: Little Miami school board member calls for president's removal, police intervention at heated special meeting
item.description: After a vote to remove a poster displaying trans and LGBTQ symbols, the Little Miami school board called a special meeting to clarify its intent. There, one member called for the president's removal.
